summary: The strongest 2026-08-19 selection centers on jet-medium theory systematics, quarkonium transport foundations, and validation-first physics AI. Key topics include thermal-QCD scattering approximations for qhat/ehat extraction, Lindblad-to-Boltzmann quarkonium dynamics, elliptic-flow distortion of jet wakes, symbolic-regression emulators for intermediate-energy collective flow, normalizing-flow ensembles for chiral EFT interactions, diffusion-prior dense-matter inference, and statistical validation standards for robust AI in fundamental physics.
strongest_paper: arXiv:2608.17161 gives a focused framework for theoretical systematic uncertainties in jet-medium Monte Carlo constraints, directly addressing qhat/ehat extraction reliability.

papers.title: Closed-form expressions for tree-level gluon-gluon scattering: a framework for obtaining theoretical systematic uncertainties for jet-medium Monte Carlo simulations
papers.authors: Lukas Opitz; Hemanth Regi; Gojko Vujanovic
papers.abstract: Modern Bayesian theory-to-data comparisons for jet-medium interactions lack careful accounting of theoretical systematic uncertainties. The paper revisits tree-level gluon-gluon scattering in thermal QCD, finds deviations from common approximations, and uses them to estimate systematics for qhat and ehat in Bayesian analysis.

papers.title: The high-energy behavior of tree-level scattering in finite-temperature QCD: estimates of theoretical systematic uncertainty in jet-medium Monte Carlo simulations
papers.authors: Lukas Opitz; Hemanth Regi; Gojko Vujanovic
papers.abstract: The authors examine high-energy thermal-QCD scattering and argue that common approximations bias scattering rates and qhat, motivating a covariance-style theory uncertainty for jet-medium Monte Carlo analyses.

papers.title: From the universal Lindblad equation to Boltzmann equations: in-QGP quarkonium dynamics
papers.authors: Aoumeur Daddi Hammou; Pol Bernard Gossiaux
papers.abstract: The paper derives pNRQCD/NRQCD universal Lindblad equations and their semiclassical limit, yielding coupled singlet-octet Boltzmann equations for quarkonium in the QGP, including beyond-small-dipole behavior and a leading quantum correction.

papers.title: The elliptic wind on jet wakes in high-energy heavy-ion collisions
papers.authors: Kai-Yi Wu; Zhong Yang; Xin-Nian Wang
papers.abstract: The authors calculate how elliptic density gradients and flow distort jet-induced medium response, proposing in-plane/out-of-plane gamma-jet soft-hadron correlation differences as probes of wake broadening and viscosity sensitivity.

papers.title: Symbolic Regression for Interpretable Emulation of Proton Collective Flow in Intermediate-Energy Heavy-Ion Collisions
papers.authors: Nicholas Cox; Xavier Grundler; Bao-An Li
papers.abstract: Symbolic-regression emulators reproduce IBUU proton flow observables with DNN-comparable accuracy while providing analytic expressions and fast inference; inverse symbolic relations estimate an in-medium NN cross-section modification factor.

papers.title: VERaiPHY -- Validation & Evaluation for Robust AI in PHYsics
papers.authors: Gaia Grosso; Ramon Winterhalder; Lydia Brenner; Louis Lyons; Tilman Plehn
papers.abstract: The opening VERaiPHY article establishes probabilistic, statistical, and ML foundations for later PHYSTAT articles on validation, uncertainty quantification, and robustness of AI methods in fundamental physics.

papers.title: Generative artificial intelligence for reconstructing neutron-star matter
papers.authors: Julia Yu. Panteleeva; Herzallah Alharazin; Evgeny Epelbaum
papers.abstract: A denoising diffusion model learns a physics-motivated EOS prior for neutron-star matter while imposing perturbative-QCD and astrophysical constraints exactly; inferred radii and tidal deformabilities align with Gaussian-process and heavy-ion-informed results.

papers.title: Data-Driven Statistical Ensembles of Chiral Nuclear Interactions
papers.abstract: Normalizing flows infer joint probability distributions of chiral EFT low-energy constants over multiple resolution scales, reproducing neutron-proton phase-shift distributions and revealing non-Gaussian correlations.

papers.title: Bound-state spectra of chi_cJ in finite nuclei and the universal pattern of mass levels
papers.authors: Tian-Le Gao; Ze-Hua Zhang; Xiang Liu
papers.abstract: The paper predicts chi_cJ-nuclear bound states across finite nuclei using in-medium mass shifts from virtual D meson loops, with level-spacing systematics that scale approximately as A^(-2/3), but absolute binding energies depend strongly on the cutoff parameter.
